summary.text: Andrew Ziemba is the Republican candidate for Connecticut House of Representatives District 17 in the November 3, 2026 general election, against incumbent Eleni Kavros DeGraw (D).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he works as a residential solar consultant and has served on the Canton Board of Finance and the Ridgefield Board of Assessment Appeals.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Ziemba earned a high school diploma from Canton High School, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he graduated in 2005, has lived in Canton most of his life, and is the son of a Polish immigrant.
He said he started small businesses selling books on Amazon and preowned clothing on eBay before becoming a residential solar consultant.

Ziemba listed three campaign messages in the survey: reducing property taxes through reform of Education Cost Sharing funding and fewer unfunded mandates, lowering electricity costs, and protecting local control over zoning and development.
He said he supports eliminating the public benefits charge and investing in nuclear and natural gas while continuing to support solar.
He listed endorsements including the Connecticut Fraternal Order of Police.
